Evergreen, Colorado · eat

Restaurants in Evergreen for cyclists

Where to eat in Evergreen the night before a ride and the afternoon after. Nothing fancy. Real food, real portions, places that are open when you need them.

For: Triple Bypass.

Restaurants in Evergreen for cyclists, listed

  1. Willow Creek

    Seasonal American · 29029 Upper Bear Creek Rd, Evergreen, CO 80439

    Across from Evergreen Lake with a big patio; lunch, brunch and dinner, closed Monday and Tuesday most of the year.

  2. Lariat Lodge Brewing Company

    Brewpub · 27618 Fireweed Drive, Evergreen, CO 80439

    House beer and pub food on Bear Creek, open daily 11 to 9.

  3. Muddy Buck Coffee House

    Coffee, breakfast, lunch · 28065 Highway 74, Suite 101, Evergreen, CO 80439

    Downtown roaster in the old Evergreen Hotel building; opens 7 AM weekdays, 8 AM weekends.

  4. The Wildflower Cafe

    Breakfast and lunch · 28035 Highway 74, Evergreen, CO 80439

    Scratch-made breakfast downtown, open daily 7:30 AM to 2 PM.

  5. Beau Jo's Colorado Style Pizza

    Pizza · 28186 Highway 74, Evergreen, CO 80439

    Mountain pie by the pound; the easy post-ride carb stop downtown.
